Segmentation FAQ

Segments are updated automatically in real-time.

Unlike other platforms, Acme allows you to go as far back in time as your data allows, without any additional charge.

Use any piece of data (and metadata) from 350+ integrations and flexible APIs. That includes demographic data, browsing behavior, purchase history, products purchased, channel preferences, location, regional compliance information, loyalty points, open support tickets, order status, subscription status—plus unlimited custom properties.

Segments AI uses metrics across all the data in your account, including integrations, custom API events, and predictive analytics to build the segments you want. For example, you could input “I want to create a segment of customers who have opened a support ticket, placed an order over the last 30 days, and who have a predicted CLV of $500” and AI will pull in all those relevant metrics to create the segment. For more information on Segments AI, check out our Help Center.

Because Acme stores event data at the profile level indefinitely, you can get super granular in segmentation over any period of time, at no additional cost. No other platform offers the granularity and flexibility that Acme offers.
